shippingBasis: Quantity-one B2Sign Next Day quotes to Louisville KY 40241; other destinations and unquoted combinations need approval.
profitDefinition: Selling price less supplier cost, shipping and estimated processing; excludes advertising, labor, overhead, reprints and taxes. Not net profit.
rounding: Choose cent-rounded retail closest to 30% after separately rounding discount and estimated fees; not an upward floor.
